lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of large, high-luminance circular spots are visible along the lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit, following a structured grid-like arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible across the flank, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a matrix of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal half of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the upper surface and shadows below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-frequency white spots that are significantly smaller and more closely packed than those on the lateral flank.
